source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: ("small towns" OR "small town") AND (urban OR urbanisation OR urbanization)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:("small towns" OR "small town") AND (urban OR urbanisation OR urbanization),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("small town" OR "small towns") AND ("urban" OR "urbanisation" OR "urbanization"))
